list: the official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), as published 2026-11-18
note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official wording. Guides are original text written for this entry; each names its sources. Counts are the targets PlayStation tracks, as listed by PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing extra to chase here: work the five-stage roadmap in this guide and this one lands last. Keep a separate save before the final mission so the missable story trophies can still be cleaned up afterwards.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: simply play through the game's first mission to its end and the trophy pops as the mission completes. Use the opening to learn the driving and partner-switching basics before the map opens up.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing every story mission in Chapter 1. Follow the chapter's mission markers in order; the trophy fires when the chapter's final mission ends. Nothing in Chapter 1 can lock you out of it, but finish any Chapter 1 side strands you care about before moving on, since some stranger strands advance with the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2's story missions. Play the chapter through to its closing mission; the trophy unlocks automatically at the chapter break. Chapter 2 is a good time to start the collectible sweeps (meditation spots, WAiNK locations, vehicles) because the map is largely open by then.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3. Finish the chapter's final story mission and the trophy pops at the chapter transition. Several named-mission trophies sit inside this stretch, so keep an eye on the missable flags in this guide while you play through it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 4. Play to the end of the chapter's last mission. Before starting Chapter 4's finale, make a manual save: the endgame approaches after this chapter, and a pre-finale save is your insurance for the missable trophies flagged in this guide.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Gold trophy for finishing the game's final story mission. It is unmissable if you play the story to its end, but do not rush it: first bank the missable trophies and partner free-roam trophies in this guide, and keep a save from before the final mission so nothing story-bound is lost.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the named mission Breakfast Run. Play that mission through to completion when it appears on your mission list; the trophy unlocks as the mission ends. Named-mission trophies like this one are unmissable as long as you keep following the story markers.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission The Cartel Heist. Stock up on armour and ammunition before starting it, since heist missions tend to end in a shootout and a getaway. The trophy pops when the mission's final objective is done; it cannot be missed on a normal story playthrough.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Child's Play. Follow the mission from its marker to its last objective; the trophy unlocks on completion. If a mission ever fails, use the retry checkpoint rather than reloading an old save, so your collectible progress stays intact.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Headliners. Play it through when it unlocks in the story chain; the trophy fires at mission end. Unmissable on any playthrough that follows the main story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission's objectives in order; the trophy unlocks as it ends. VCIA also features in the missable Catch Me If You Can, so read that entry before playing VCIA missions and keep a save from before them.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Operation Savage Glory. Bring your best weapons and full armour; operation-style missions in this series lean on extended firefights. The trophy pops at mission completion and is unmissable while following the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion on the in-game completion tracker. That means the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles the tracker counts — use this guide's checklist as your ledger and finish the count-based trophies (stunts, challenges, races, collectibles) along the way, because they overlap heavily with the 100% requirements. Check the pause-menu stats screen to see exactly which categories still owe you percentage points.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts
PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 250 stunts; PlayStation tracks the count at 250. Stunt jumps, wheelies, stoppies and air-time feats in free roam all feed the counter, so grind them in short bursts between missions rather than in one sitting. A fast bike on the coastal highways and bridge ramps is the quickest way to rack them up; check your stats screen to watch the running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — PlayStation tracks 9 types. Work through the activity icons on the map (races, fishing, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest) and start each one at least once; you do not need to win, only to take part. Keep a note of which types you have sampled, because the game does not list the missing ones for you.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total, per PlayStation's tracked count. Visit a shooting range and clear each weapon's challenge set; gold usually demands near-perfect accuracy streaks, so learn each pattern's spawn order before going for speed. Do this late in the game once you are comfortable with the aiming, and replay any challenge freely — failed attempts cost nothing but time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts
PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations PlayStation tracks. Find the drone-race markers on the map, enter each race and finish first; a win at a location is banked permanently, so note which venues you have already won. Drone handling rewards smooth lines over raw speed — brake before tight gates rather than bouncing off them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Enter street races from their map markers across Leonida and win each distinct event once; upgrading your car at a garage before racing makes the later, longer events far easier. The stats screen shows how many unique race wins you have banked.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat the character Cal in a fishing challenge. Take up the fishing activity when it becomes available, practise the timing on ordinary catches first, then accept Cal's challenge and out-fish him. If you lose, the challenge can be retried — nothing about this trophy is one-shot.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game from start to its end screen. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, play a full game through rather than quitting mid-run, and the trophy unlocks when the game completes. The shortest cabinet game you can find is the fastest route.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Andy's mission strand. Stranger and side-character strands unlock in steps, so keep returning to Andy's marker whenever a new mission appears until the strand's final mission is done. This strand also counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Work through each of Kenton's missions as they unlock; the trophy fires when the strand's closing mission ends. Like Andy's strand, this one feeds the Strangers & Freaks total of 8 completed strands.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing its final mission. Billy's missions appear in sequence; play each one as it becomes available until the strand closes and the trophy unlocks. Counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands in this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each count once finished, so clear those five first, then hunt the remaining stranger markers (the question-mark icons) and finish three more strands end to end. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, not when it is started.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts
PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the last mission in Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions in order as they unlock; the trophy pops at the strand's finale. One of the strands that counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing its final mission. Keep checking back at Tyrone's marker between story missions, since strand missions often unlock one at a time; the trophy unlocks when the strand ends. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida. Sweep region by region with the map open, trigger the meditate prompt at each scenic spot, and tick them off in this tracker as you go so none is visited twice. None of the spots is story-locked, so this can be finished in free roam at any point after the map opens.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting request when it appears, track the marked animal to its habitat, and bring it down cleanly with a rifle from range so it does not flee. Deliver or report back as the objective asks and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards come from packs and pickups around Leonida; open packs whenever you pass a shop that sells them and check the collection screen to see which cards each set still needs. Finish any three sets in full — the trophy fires when the third set completes. Trading duplicates where the game allows it speeds the last few cards of a set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for using WAiNK It at 100 locations. Whenever you reach a new landmark, viewpoint or named place, open the WAiNK app and register the spot; 100 distinct locations are needed, so combine this with the exploration trophy The Goodtime State and log a WAiNK in every new area you enter. The app keeps its own tally of logged locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Open the challenges menu, pick the quickest categories first (driving feats, combat feats, exploration), and work down the list in free roam; each completed challenge is banked permanently. Fifty is a long grind, so chip away at a few per session alongside the collectible sweeps.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you in free roam, raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars (a sustained crime spree in view of police does it), then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear completely. Do this before the final mission while your partner is freely available in the open world, and park a fast car near a tunnel or underpass beforehand for a clean escape route.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, rob three shops one after another while keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time — do not hide, do not let the stars fade between robberies. Pick three shops on the same street so the drive between them is short, rob each register at gunpoint, and move straight to the next. Like Hot Together, do this before the final mission while your partner roams freely with you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting into a vehicle model for the first time registers it. Steal and sit in everything you pass: traffic cars, parked trucks, boats at marinas, bikes, and the rarer spawns near the airport and docks. The vehicle collection screen tracks how many distinct models you have found, so sweep a new district whenever the count stalls.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded firefight — a gang hideout or a story shootout with enemies grouped together — trigger Combat Focus with a full meter, and drop five targets before it ends. A rifle with a large magazine makes the five kills far easier; if you fall short, let the meter refill and try again at the next fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE: tied to a one-time VCIA story moment — make an unscheduled departure from VCIA (the airport) during the relevant mission sequence rather than leaving the normal way. Keep a manual save before the VCIA missions (see Hi-Jacked) and, when the airport sequence plays, take the unscripted exit the objective allows instead of the scheduled route. If the moment passes, reload that save and replay the sequence.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: MISSABLE: the description points at a scripted Rhino (tank) sequence — get inside a Rhino when the story puts one in front of you and complete that segment. Because Rhinos only appear in set-piece moments, save before any military or operation mission (Operation Savage Glory is the obvious candidate) and, if the trophy has not popped by the mission's end, reload and take the tank route through it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted at any point. Scout the store first, note the guard and camera positions, then slip in, take the loot and leave without raising an alarm or a Wanted Level. If you are detected, break off, lose the heat, and try again another night — the store can be robbed again, so this is not one-shot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping after each one. Each vault job needs a clean getaway: park a fast car outside, grab the vault loot, and lose the Wanted Level completely before the robbery counts. Work through the bank markers across Leonida one at a time, restocking armour and ammunition between jobs; a failed escape can simply be retried.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts
PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck in free roam and escape. Block the truck's path with a vehicle, force it to stop, take the cash from the back, then lose the Wanted Level fully. Armored trucks patrol city routes, so cruise the downtown streets until one spawns; bring a sturdy vehicle, since the truck's guards shoot back.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Drive, boat and fly into each named district so its name registers on entry; the map's fog clears as you go, which makes the unexplored pockets easy to spot. Combine this with You WAiNKer! and log a WAiNK location in each new area as you enter it.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs PlayStation tracks. Find each gang's operation site, clear its defenders, take the loot and escape; one successful robbery per gang is enough. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit, since the game does not name the missing ones, and restock between raids — operation sites are heavily guarded.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE: an early-game moment on Ocean Beach — enjoy a cocktail with a view there while the opening chapters still have you in the area. When the story first brings you to Ocean Beach, look for the beachfront bar spot with a view and take the cocktail prompt before pressing on with the next mission. If you move on without it, reload a save from the opening chapters; the moment is tied to the early story window.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE: during the showroom story sequence, smash your way out through the showroom glass in a vehicle instead of using the door. When a mission puts you inside a vehicle showroom, get into a car on the floor and drive straight out through the window. Save before showroom-related missions; if you leave on foot and the moment passes, reload and take the car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a game with proper follow-through. Head to the alley's map marker, start a game, and play it to the final frame; a finished game is what counts, not a winning score. Bowling is also one of the activity types for Master of None, so this visit covers both.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: MISSABLE: a scripted partnership story beat — the description ties it to a specific moment with your partner in front of a crowd. Because it is a one-time story scene, keep a manual save before each chapter's later missions; when a partner mission reaches a public set-piece, play it through without skipping the scene. If the story moves past it without the trophy, reload the pre-mission save and replay that mission.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.guide: MISSABLE in spirit: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 for this trophy, and the description says it is about choices made. Every dialogue and mission choice you commit to feeds the counter, so answer prompts instead of letting them time out, and never skip choice scenes. Because choices are made once per playthrough, a player who rushes past them can end the story short of the count — keep a pre-finale save so the last stretch can be replayed with choices taken.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: MISSABLE: a scripted second-attempt moment — fail or fall short on the first try of the relevant story beat, then succeed when the game gives you the second chance. The safe play is to keep a save before story missions with a retry structure; if you succeed first time and the trophy does not pop, reload and deliberately take the second attempt the scene offers.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: MISSABLE: witness the game's strange, unexplained event when it triggers. Odd one-off events in this series are tied to a place and a story window, so when the story sends you somewhere remote or a stranger hints at something weird, follow it up immediately rather than postponing it. Keep a rolling manual save through the middle chapters; if the event passes unseen, reload the save from before that stretch.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a person down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, lean out and swing a melee weapon into a pedestrian as you pass. A slow cruise down a busy sidewalk on a bike makes the timing easy; one clean knockdown is enough. Expect a small Wanted Level — lose it afterwards and carry on.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide hub

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heist-style jobs; take them to your laundering contacts whenever your stash builds up and convert them in batches. Robbing armored trucks and bank vaults (see A Classic Blitz Play and Maximum Withdrawal) feeds this counter fastest, and the laundered total is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Weapons, clothing, vehicle upgrades and card packs all count, so this fills naturally as you gear up; if it is still short late in the game, buy high-end vehicle upgrades and the priciest weapons. The total is cumulative and never resets, so there is no rush — just avoid hoarding cash to the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages appear as purchasable property markers as the story opens new districts; save your robbery and laundering income and buy each garage when it becomes available. Owning them also helps Whip It Good, since stored vehicles are easy to re-enter. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and tracked counts

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you take ownership of a vehicle, open the app and register it; ten distinct registrations are needed. Combine this with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover for that trophy is a candidate to register here until the count reaches 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
